customers: Record source and consent in the private CRM.
Capture needs and a responsible next contact.
Link a trial booking to the lead and customer.
Confirm actual attendance, not just a booking.
Use completed visits to establish participation.
Link active entitlement to the customer.
Use an agreed milestone definition and review before outreach.
Review lapse or service issues with context; no risk score without an approved rule.
Record permission, outreach and resulting attendance.
Recognise consented referrals without exposing identities.
classes: Approved class type, instructor, start/end, location and capacity.
Check entitlement and capacity atomically in the future backend.
Maintain ordering, promotion and customer consent.
Distinguish booking status from actual attendance.
Record completion and reconcile the session roster.
Review attendance and the approved policy before follow-up.
memberships: Approved eligibility and entitlement; no assumed price.
Track validity and remaining credits from the ledger.
Record product, approved terms, dates and payment reference.
Record authorised dates and reason in the private system.
Calculate from approved dates and terms, not a guessed policy.
Preserve entitlement history and approval reference.
Route for review; never treat failure as revenue.
sales: Capture source, permission and next action.
Record contact time, owner and outcome.
Use approved timing and communication consent.
Link booking to the originating lead.
Verify completed visit before conversion reporting.
Use an agreed conversion definition and confirmed entitlement.
Retain reason if known; do not fabricate it.
staff: Private profile, credential reference and approval to teach.
Link instructor to session and verify coverage.
Confirm the replacement and approval before reassignment.
Capture start/end and attendance in a restricted system.
Record training completion and expiry references privately.
Review attendance, session activity and feedback with context; no public ranking.
operations: Use the opening checklist and record readiness.
Inspect by approved checklist; do not infer safety from the 3D model.
Record completion, zone and checklist version.
Isolate equipment and escalate to an authorised person.
Assign repair, preserve service history and evidence.
Require an authorised safety decision and sign-off.
Capture and restrict incident details; route human review.
Reconcile issues and pass unresolved actions to the next shift.
retention: Capture the channel, consent and follow-up need.
Ask only using approved consent and outreach rules.
Assign a person and record a fair resolution.
Use completed visits and agreed milestone definitions.
Use an approved observation window; missing data is not inactivity.
Record outreach and outcome without automatic sensitive messaging.

exceptions: Trial attended without a next step

Daily.definition: Scheduled / completed sessions by local studio date
Confirmed and cancelled bookings; separate waitlist
Completed visits and checked-in visits shown separately
Completed visits ÷ usable offered places; exclude cancelled sessions
No-show visits ÷ eligible confirmed bookings; exclusions require policy
Customers with their earliest completed visit in the period
Confirmed conversions under an approved definition
Confirmed payments and refunds reported separately; revenue recognition requires policy
Unresolved failed transactions without double counting retries
New and unresolved incidents; restricted details
New faults, unresolved faults and unavailable equipment
Due or unresolved actions by responsible owner

Weekly.definition: New first-visit customers; active population movement under approved definition
Converted trial cohort ÷ attended trial cohort, with an approved conversion window
Returning eligible customers ÷ defined starting cohort; cohort/window awaiting approval
Attendance, offered capacity and no-shows by class type
Assigned/completed sessions and attendance; contextual inputs only
Starts, renewals, freezes, expiries and cancellations
Created → contacted → trial booked → attended → converted by cohort
Open feedback/recovery actions and resolution times
Open faults, incidents and handover actions by age

Monthly.definition: Compare confirmed net cash activity by currency; do not equate cash with recognised revenue
Distinct customers meeting the approved activity window
Valid entitlements at period end, with freeze handling defined
Approved starting cohort and exit definition; denominator documented
Completed visits ÷ offered usable places over the period
Net confirmed payments ÷ defined paying-customer population; currency separated
Participation, entitlement use and approved net cash allocation
Session activity, training and consented feedback for human review
Lead and conversion cohorts by source; spend only when authoritative
Fault recurrence, downtime and completed maintenance
Decisions, owners, due dates, evidence and follow-through
